tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: What changed lately in any of the datasets (or only the `datasets` named), newest first, with the date and source of each. Optional `since` (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: cite
tools.description: How to cite a dataset, a state or one record: the citation sentence, credit line, DOI and URL to cite. CC BY 4.0 asks for credit and a link.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Every public dataset on this server: what it covers, its version, DOI, license (CC BY 4.0), credit line, last-checked date, the page to cite, its files and its tools.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Law-firm marketing benchmarks (ad costs, call outcomes, speed to sign), as bands, tiers and rounded values with the methods page to cite.

tools.name: search_ethics_opinions
tools.description: Bar ethics opinions (ABA and state) on lawyer marketing, e.g. pay-per-lead, Google reviews, AI chatbots, referral fees, social media. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: One state's lawyer advertising rule on one topic, e.g. can a firm text leads, record intake calls, pay referral fees, what disclaimer every ad must include. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: data_lookup
tools.description: Figures for one state, county or other key from one open dataset, e.g. limitation periods, lawyers per resident, bankruptcy filings, law firms, court backlogs. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_ad_platform_policies
tools.description: What Google Ads, Local Services Ads, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and ChatGPT ads allow for law-firm ads: eligibility, verification, targeting, creative. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: data_search
tools.description: Find records by words across the open datasets when you do not know the key, e.g. "nursing home abuse" or "legal services price index". Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_state_rules
tools.description: Every lawyer advertising rule for one US state or DC in one call: filing, disclaimers, waiting periods, claims, referrals, language, recording, texting, privacy. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_ad_filing_requirements
tools.description: Whether a state's bar requires lawyers to file or submit ads for review, which ads, when. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: list_mdl_dockets
tools.description: Federal multidistrict litigation (MDL) dockets from the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation's monthly pending-dockets reports, largest first. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Id search for deep-research clients: returns ids, titles and URLs to read with fetch; the named tools answer one question directly.

tools.name: list_rule_changes
tools.description: Recent confirmed changes to state lawyer advertising rules only, newest first, with the date, state, rules touched and primary source of each.

tools.name: get_spanish_demand_supply
tools.description: Spanish speakers with limited English per Spanish-speaking lawyer in one US state, DC, the US or a metro area (Census ACS). Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: check_ad_elements
tools.description: Which of one state's lawyer ad rules an ad touches, from what it contains (testimonials, past results, expert claims, actors, Spanish, AI) or its text. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: calculate_fee_cap
tools.description: The most a lawyer may charge, in dollars, on one award, settlement or past-due benefit, where a legal fee limit gives one figure.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: Which states do what: one ad-rule topic (e.g. the waiting period before contacting accident victims, texting, filing) side by side across states, or all 50 and DC. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_state_market_brief
tools.description: Every public number about marketing a law firm in one state or DC, joined from nine open datasets. Each figure carries its source and check date. Not a forecast. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_attorney_fee_caps
tools.description: The fee-cap rules (percent and dollar limits on attorney fees) for one state or federal program: workers' comp, med-mal, contingency, SSDI, FTCA, VA. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: get_ca_court_filings
tools.description: California only: cases filed in one county's superior court (or CA for the whole state) in fiscal year 2024-25, by case type, with the prior year. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one record found with search (ids like rules:TX:filing, opinions:ny-nysba-1306 or benchmarks:speed-to-sign). Not legal advice.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Keyword search across all rule text, for a word or claim such as "expert" or "guaranteed results". Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: data_compare
tools.description: Compare up to 10 states, counties or other keys of one dataset side by side, e.g. lawyer pay or bar pass rates in two states. Results are not legal advice.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: search

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: fetch

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_ethics_opinions, get_ad_filing_requirements, search · Private data: cite, list_datasets, get_rule, data_search, get_ad_filing_requirements, fetch · Public sink: get_ad_filing_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_ethics_opinions, get_ad_filing_requirements, search · Private data: cite, list_datasets, get_rule, data_search, get_ad_filing_requirements, fetch · Public sink: get_ad_filing_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
